page.overview:
Who is Tanat?

Tanat was a Fremen who assisted Liet Kynes.

Tanat was stationed at an ecological testing station alongside Shamir. Upon her arrival at the station with Paul Atreides, Lady Jessica and Duncan Idaho, Dr. Liet Kynes ordered him to find stillsuits for them to wear.
